activities.name: Initiative Swap
activities.note: Immediately after rolling Initiative, swap your initiative with a willing ally's. Neither of you may be Incapacitated.

activities.name: Lucky (Advantage)
activities.note: When you roll a d20 for a D20 Test, spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll.

activities.name: Lucky (Disadvantage)
activities.note: When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, spend 1 Luck Point to impose Disadvantage. Shares the Luck Point pool with luck-advantage; v0 models them as separate resources for simplicity.

activities.name: Magic Initiate 1st-Level Spell
activities.note: Cast the chosen 1st-level spell once without a spell slot; can also cast it using any spell slot of an appropriate level. Two cantrips are also learned (no resource cost).

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Magic Initiate: two cantrips + one 1st-level spell from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list. Spellcasting ability is INT/WIS/CHA (player's choice on selection). Repeatable; different list each time. Modeled here as the Wizard variant; create separate -cleric/-druid feat rows for the other two lists, or have the UI pick the list as a choice attached to a single slug.

modifiers.name: Savage Attacker
modifiers.note: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll. v0 evaluator does not implement the 'damage.reroll-and-keep-higher' target — this surfaces as a tagged modifier only.

data.note: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice. Repeatable. The actual choices live on the character document (character.proficienciesChosen) and are merged in by the engine; no stat-modifier rows are emitted at the feat level because the choice is per-character.

2024 Tough grants +2 HP per character level (HP max increases by 2*characterLevel on take, then +2 each level after). Modeled as two stat-modifiers both targeting hp.max with value 'totalLevel' (1 per level each = +2/level total) since the evaluator doesn't support arithmetic on magic identifiers in v0.

2024 SRD 5.2 Great Weapon Master. Heavy Weapon Mastery: hit with a Heavy weapon as part of the Attack action -> extra damage equal to proficiency bonus (no longer the -5/+10 toggle of 2014). Hew: after a crit OR reducing a creature to 0 with a melee weapon, bonus-action attack with the same weapon. No explicit per-turn limit in the 2024 text on Hew.
2024 SRD 5.2 Sharpshooter. The 2014 -5/+10 toggle was removed in 2024. v0 evaluator does not implement the cover / range / melee-proximity targets — these surface as tagged modifiers only.

activities.name: Pole Strike (Bonus-Action Butt-End)
activities.note: Immediately after taking the Attack action and attacking with a quarterstaff, spear, or heavy+reach weapon, you can make a bonus-action melee attack with the opposite end. d4 bludgeoning + STR; same proficiency as the parent weapon. v0 models this as a standalone activity; tie-in to the parent Attack action is enforced narratively, not by the engine.

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Polearm Master. Pole Strike requires the parent Attack-action attack to have been with a quarterstaff, spear, or heavy+reach weapon (e.g., glaive, halberd, pike). Reactive Strike is a normal melee attack (not an opportunity attack), so Sentinel's Halt does NOT trigger off it.

2024 SRD 5.2 Sentinel. Guardian: when a creature within 5 ft of you takes the Disengage action OR hits a target other than you, take a reaction to make an Opportunity Attack against that creature. Halt: on a hit with an Opportunity Attack, target's Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn. v0 evaluator does not implement on-hit.target.speed; surfaces as tagged modifier only.

grants.constraint: 1-action casting time, targets only the provoking creature

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 War Caster. The spell cast via Reactive Spell must have a casting time of one action and target only the provoking creature. v0 evaluator does not implement save.advantage.concentration or spellcasting.somatic-with-occupied-hands; surface as tagged modifiers only.

2024 SRD 5.2 Resilient. Choose one ability you lack save proficiency in; +1 to that ability (max 20) and gain saving-throw proficiency in it. The +1 and save-proficiency are emitted by the engine from character.feats[].choices.ability (analogous to background ASI distribution). No fixed modifiers at the feat level because the ability is per-character.

2024 SRD 5.2 Crafter. Gain proficiency with three Artisan's Tools of your choice. Nonmagical items bought from a shop cost 20% less. Craft items in half the time during a Long Rest. v0 evaluator does not implement shopping/crafting hooks — surfaces as a tagged modifier only. The three tool choices live on the character document (character.feats[].choices.tools).

activities.name: Healer's Kit (Stabilize)
activities.note: Use a Healer's Kit charge to stabilize a creature without a Medicine check, and that creature regains 1 HP.

activities.name: Healer's Mend
activities.note: As a Utilize action, spend one charge of a Healer's Kit to restore 1d6 + 4 HP + your character level. A creature can't be healed by this again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Healer. Two uses of a Healer's Kit charge. v0 cannot track Short Rest gating on a per-creature basis — Healer's Mend surfaces as a note.

activities.name: Encouraging Song
activities.note: At the end of a Short or Long Rest, you can give a Musical Instrument performance and bestow Heroic Inspiration on a number of allies up to your Proficiency Bonus who heard the performance.

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Musician. Gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments. v0 does not track Heroic Inspiration — surfaces as a note.

grants.constraint: Once per turn after hitting with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon, push target 5 ft.

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Tavern Brawler. Unarmed Strike damage becomes 1d4 bludgeoning. Proficient with improvised weapons. Free reroll: once per turn, when you roll a damage die for an unarmed strike or improvised weapon, you can reroll once and use either result (v0 does not model the reroll). Push: after hitting with an unarmed strike or improvised, can push target up to 5 ft.

2024 SRD 5.2 Ability Score Improvement. Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20 per ability). Player picks stored as feat.choices.asis: Array<{ability,bonus}>. Engine synthesizes ADD stat-modifiers from each entry, capped at asiBudget total.

grants.constraint: Either +1d8 damage on the bonus-action attack, or push the target up to 10 ft as part of the hit.

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Charger. When you take the Dash action and move at least 10 ft in a straight line, you can use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack OR shove. On hit: +1d8 damage OR push the target 10 ft away. v0 surfaces the option as a trigger; the choice between extra damage and shove is player-side.

grants.constraint: Draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you'd normally only be able to draw/stow one.

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Dual Wielder. Enhanced Dual Wielding: can use two-weapon fighting with weapons that are one-handed (don't need to be Light). +1 AC while wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand. Quick Draw: can draw/stow two weapons when you'd normally draw/stow only one. v0 evaluator does not model the 'one-handed but not Light' allowance — surfaces as a note.

2024 SRD 5.2 Elemental Adept. Choose one of: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Spells you cast ignore Resistance to that damage type, and when rolling spell damage of that type, treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2. Repeatable; new damage type each time. v0 does not yet implement damage.ignore-resistance or damage.die.min — surfaces as tagged modifiers only. The chosen type lives on the character document.

grants.constraint: After making a melee attack against a creature this turn (hit or miss), you do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn.

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Mobile. +10 walking speed. Dashing through Difficult Terrain doesn't cost extra movement on your turn. After making a melee attack vs a creature, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature for the rest of your turn. v0 does not model dash-difficult-terrain target — surfaces as tagged modifier.

grants.constraint: Add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against the triggering attack, possibly turning a hit into a miss.

data.note: 2024 SRD 5.2 Defensive Duelist. When wielding a Finesse weapon and hit by a melee attack, use Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against that attack (possibly turning a hit into a miss).

activities.name: Magic Initiate 1st-Level Spell
activities.note: Cast the chosen 1st-level Cleric spell once without a spell slot; can also cast it using any spell slot of an appropriate level. Two Cleric cantrips are also learned (no resource cost). On level-up you may replace one chosen spell with another of the same level from the Cleric list.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Magic Initiate (Cleric). Two cantrips + one 1st-level spell from the Cleric list. Spellcasting ability is INT, WIS, or CHA (chosen at feat selection). Repeatable; must choose a different spell list each time. Spell Change: on gaining a new level you can swap one chosen spell for another of the same level from the Cleric list.

activities.name: Magic Initiate 1st-Level Spell
activities.note: Cast the chosen 1st-level Druid spell once without a spell slot; can also cast it using any spell slot of an appropriate level. Two Druid cantrips are also learned (no resource cost). On level-up you may replace one chosen spell with another of the same level from the Druid list.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Magic Initiate (Druid). Two cantrips + one 1st-level spell from the Druid list. Spellcasting ability is INT, WIS, or CHA (chosen at feat selection). Repeatable; must choose a different spell list each time. Spell Change: on gaining a new level you can swap one chosen spell for another of the same level from the Druid list.

grants.constraint: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Grappler. Ability Score Increase: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). Punch and Grab: once per turn, hitting a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action lets you use both the Damage and Grapple option simultaneously. Attack Advantage: you have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you. Fast Wrestler: no extra movement cost to move a creature Grappled by you if it is your size or smaller. v0 evaluator does not evaluate the conditional attack advantage or the free-movement grapple rule from predicates at runtime; Fast Wrestler surfaces as a note.
SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Archery. +2 bonus to attack rolls made with Ranged weapons. Prerequisite: must have a class feature that grants a Fighting Style feat.
SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Defense. +1 AC while wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor. Prerequisite: must have a class feature that grants a Fighting Style feat.

modifiers.name: Great Weapon Fighting Reroll
modifiers.note: When rolling damage for a melee attack with a Two-Handed or Versatile weapon held in two hands, treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. v0 evaluator does not implement damage.reroll-1s-and-2s — surfaces as a tagged modifier only.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting. Prerequisite: must have a class feature that grants a Fighting Style feat.

modifiers.name: Two-Weapon Fighting Damage
modifiers.note: When making the extra attack granted by the Light property, add your ability modifier to that attack's damage if you aren't already. The engine should apply the relevant STR/DEX modifier; using dexMod here as the default for ranged/finesse. The DM or engine may substitute strMod for STR-based builds.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting. When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon with the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren't already adding it. Prerequisite: must have a class feature that grants a Fighting Style feat.
SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Blind Fighting. You gain Blindsight to a range of 10 feet.

modifiers.name: Dueling Damage
modifiers.note: +2 damage when wielding a melee weapon in one hand. The 'no other weapons held' constraint is not engine-enforced.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Dueling. +2 damage when wielding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons.

SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Interception. Reaction to reduce damage to an ally within 5 ft by 1d10 + Proficiency Bonus. Reaction trigger and damage reduction are encounter-layer mechanics not supported by the engine — surfaced as a trait flag.

SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Protection. Reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 5 ft (requires shield). Reaction and disadvantage imposition are encounter-layer mechanics not supported by the engine — surfaced as a trait flag.
SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting. +2 damage with thrown weapons. The 'draw as part of attack' benefit is encounter-layer behavior.
SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Blessed Warrior (Paladin). Learn two Cleric cantrips. CHA is your spellcasting ability for them. SRD cleric cantrips: sacred-flame, toll-the-dead, guidance, light.
SRD 5.2 Fighting Style: Druidic Warrior (Ranger). Learn two Druid cantrips. WIS is your spellcasting ability for them. SRD druid cantrips: guidance, shillelagh.

activities.name: Peerless Aim
activities.note: When you miss with an attack roll, you can choose to hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Epic Boon of Combat Prowess. Ability Score Increase: +1 to one ability score (max 30). Peerless Aim: once per turn, when you miss an attack roll, you can hit instead.

grants.constraint: Immediately after taking the Attack action or the Magic action, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Epic Boon of Dimensional Travel. Ability Score Increase: +1 to one ability score (max 30). Blink Steps: immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

activities.name: Improve Fate
activities.note: When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once used, you can't use this again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Epic Boon of Fate. Ability Score Increase: +1 to one ability score (max 30). Improve Fate: when a creature within 60 ft succeeds or fails a D20 Test, roll 2d4 and apply as bonus or penalty; recharges on Initiative roll or Short/Long Rest.

modifiers.name: Overcome Defenses
modifiers.note: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance. v0 evaluator does not implement damage.ignore-resistance — surfaces as a tagged modifier only.

grants.constraint: When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, deal extra damage equal to the ability score increased by this feat. The extra damage type matches the attack's type.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Epic Boon of Irresistible Offense. Ability Score Increase: +1 STR or DEX (max 30). Overcome Defenses: BPS damage ignores Resistance. Overwhelming Strike: on a natural 20 attack, deal extra damage equal to the chosen ability score.

grants.constraint: Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1-4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number rolled equals the slot's level, the slot is not expended.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Epic Boon of Spell Recall. Prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting Feature. Ability Score Increase: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA (max 30). Free Casting: after casting a spell using a slot of level 1-4, roll 1d4; if the roll equals the slot level, the slot is not expended.

activities.name: Merge with Shadows
activities.note: While within Dim Light or Darkness, give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends immediately after you take an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

data.note: SRD 5.2 Epic Boon of the Night Spirit. Ability Score Increase: +1 to one ability score (max 30). Merge with Shadows: while in Dim Light or Darkness, use a Bonus Action to become Invisible (ends on any action/bonus action/reaction). Shadowy Form: while in Dim Light or Darkness, Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant. v0 evaluator cannot conditionally apply all damage resistances based on lighting; all resistance modifiers above are conditional on environment:dim-light-or-darkness and surface as tagged modifiers in bright light.

SRD 5.2 Epic Boon of Truesight. Ability Score Increase: +1 to one ability score (max 30). Truesight: you have Truesight with a range of 60 feet. The sense.truesight target is modeled analogously to sense.darkvision — v0 evaluator may need a matching evaluator path added if truesight is not yet wired.
